label: Santa Maria Nuova, Florence
summary: Hospital in Florence (Piazza di Santa Maria Nuova); it also kept deposit accounts, and Leonardo had an account there.

claims.statement: Leonardo deposited money at the hospital of Santa Maria Nuova and drew on the account in later years; the account books survive (amounts and dates not checked here).

sources.cite: Standard statement in biographies; not checked.

check_in: Villata 1999, Santa Maria Nuova deposit records

claims.statement: A note by Leonardo on an anatomical sheet at Windsor records his dissection of an old man (the centenarian) who died in the hospital of Santa Maria Nuova (sheet number not checked).
check_in: Clayton and Philo 2012, the centenarian sheet
